scope.summary: Implement raster export (JPEG/PNG-class): export selection, ranges, or all pages/spreads with quality, resolution, color space, anti-alias, bleed, and overlap, as StudioExportRecipe executions (MT-181). Implement data merge binding a data source (delimited CSV/TSV, JSON array-of-objects, or spreadsheet, including image fields by path) to placeholder fields in the layout and generating merged output; it MUST support preview records, multiple records per page with arrangement (rows-first/columns-first), margins and spacing, a repeating grid-layout mode replicating a first-cell design to all cells, content-placement options (fitting, center, link images), blank-line removal, record-range filtering, per-record QR-code fields (MT-165), and direct-to-PDF merge without an intermediate document. Data merge is a StudioExportRecipe variant; the source is embeddable in the document. Stale data-merge sources are a preflight rule (MT-183).
acceptance_criteria: raster export with full options + data merge (multi-record/grid/QR/blank-line/direct-PDF) as embeddable recipe
proof_targets: data-merge generation runtime; raster-export + grid/QR test
expected_tests: live: data merge binds a CSV+image-path source to placeholders and generates multi-record-per-page output (rows-first) + direct-to-PDF
test: raster export of ranges with resolution/color-space/bleed; repeating grid-layout mode + per-record QR + blank-line removal

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Raster export & data merge

risk_if_missed: No raster export or variable-data publishing; catalogs/mailers/badges impossible.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
